title: ochna patens
intro: Ochna patens, commonly known as the Mickey Mouse plant, is a flowering plant in the family Ochnaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Ochna patens include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can aid in pain relief and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents present in Ochna patens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, contributing to its medicinal properties.
